Author: Blackcatz1911, dajoey
Name: Lazy Currency Spender
Description: Fork of CurrencySpender by Blackcatz1911. Never wonder 'What should I do with this?' again. Access real-time prices from Universalis, identify missing collectibles tied to your currencies, and unlock new possibilities for utilizing your in-game resources effectively.
Punchline: Find the absolute best way to spend all your FFXIV currencies.
Changelog:
v1.3.1.5 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v1.3.1.4 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v1.3.1.3 (2026-10-17) [testing]
- The configuration wizard's auto-open step now sets the actual auto-open setting instead of toggling the sellables table.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v1.3.1.2 (2026-10-08) [testing]
- Added a map location for the Faux Commander (the Faux Hollows vendor in Idyllshire). Its Flag and TP buttons now draw like every other listed shop, and the plugin no longer logs a `Missing location: 1033921` error once at every startup.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v1.3.1.1 (2026-10-07) [testing]
- **Upstream sync through CurrencySpender 1.3.1.** New tracked currencies (Faux Leaf, Achievement Certificate, Oizys Credit, Auxesia Credit) and vendors (Quinnana, Faux Commander), data-driven custom-shop generation (in-code CustomShops replaces the hardcoded Cosmocredit item lists), upstream's config version migrations, and the Service.ObjectTable API rename.
- **New optional integrations:** Lifestream and vnavmesh IPC wrappers with upstream's MovementTask movement helpers, and the NPC/menu highlight services. All are gracefully skipped when the providing plugin is absent.
- Font rendering keeps the fork's Dalamud asset-font setup; the fork keeps its own tab UI (Windows/), teleport flow, Hub integration and Quick Controls.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v1.2.7.4 (2026-10-05) [testing]
- Added map locations for the two shop NPCs at the Gold Saucer that had none: the tack & feed trader at Chocobo Square and the euphoric attendant. Both now draw their Flag and TP buttons like every other listed shop instead of having no buttons at all.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
- Five shop NPCs remain without a location on purpose: the game's own data places them nowhere (no Level-sheet placement, no placement dataset entry - campaign and seasonal attendants such as Eirene's Rain Exchange and Ermina that only exist while their event runs). They keep the behaviour introduced in 1.2.7.3: one note at debug level, no buttons.
